entities.summary: Jacques Rivette was a French film director and film critic most commonly associated with the French New Wave and the film magazine Cahiers du Cinéma. He made twenty-nine films, including L'Amour fou (1969), Out 1 (1971), Céline and Julie Go Boating (1974), and La Belle Noiseuse (1991). His work is noted for its improvisation, loose narratives, and lengthy running times. Jacques Rivette was a journalists & chroniclers from Rouen (1928-03-01, Rouen–2016-01-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
